name: simulate-hecm-coordinated-boundary
why: Measured reach for both pure coordinated-HECM helpers and every caller band that consumes their results. Block N's two hostile members run in all four equivalence modes: N1 combines a legal duplicate property id with no-HECM and divergent-policy aliases, distinct lines, a cancellation-sensitive source-order capacity fold, full cent-scale allocations and a partial final allocation; N2 activates the ACA outer fixed point and counterfactual annual-pass rollback/re-entry. The default and optimizer modes observe ProjectionResult/debt, cashFlow observes exact source identities and order, and counterfactual proves discarded transactions restore caller-owned line state.

entries.label: coordinated HECM eligibility, first-HECM-row policy ownership and ordered capacity fold
entries.note: N1 reaches the no-HECM alias, first HECM-bearing policy owner, later divergent-policy duplicate, live-line and positive-capacity decisions while preserving the exact sequential binary64 fold. Start-year calls reach the early gate; whole-corpus post-death years reach its anyAlive operand. Non-property, missing-line and exhausted-line continues are supported defensive branches pinned by the focused helper suite; their conditions share reached physical lines, so the reach report separately treats them as sub-line branch evidence rather than cold whole lines.

entries.label: accepted coordinated draw allocation in unique source order
entries.note: N1 consumes two one-cent lines completely and then partially consumes a much larger line, preserving accepted-scalar subtraction order; its following no-spending loss year reaches the accepted-zero half-cent tolerance break with eligible ids present. Missing-state, repeated-id shadow and nonpositive-availability branches are impossible from the eligibility helper's returned ids in an unmodified simulator call and are pinned independently by the focused helper suite.

entries.label: coordinated HECM capacity consumption and ACA/tax accepted scalar
entries.note: N1 reaches the non-ACA outer solve with an accepted draw below total capacity. N2 establishes that multiple ACA/tax probes occur before one scalar is accepted. The focused delegation suite proves those probes do not allocate or mutate a live line.

entries.note: N1 applies three ordered rows to distinct actual lines despite no-HECM and divergent-policy duplicate aliases. Cash-flow capture publishes the exact per-property sources; counterfactual capture re-enters the annual pass and observes only the committed transaction after rollback.

readingTheCounts: A member count proves that at least one line in the named range executed. The reach command additionally fails on any cold executable whole line inside a reached range. JavaScript line coverage cannot distinguish every operand or branch sharing one physical line, so the report's cold sub-line regions and these notes must be read together with the focused helper and hostile delegation tests.
